title: Deputy Manager Digital Marketing
description:
**About Furlenco**

Furlenco is a different furniture company. We enable the urban Indian to live better today in their homes, by giving them award-winning furniture and home decor with a basket of access to rent, buy, sell and buy back.  
All of our furniture is designed in-house by experts. We don’t just give furniture. We provide decor, accessories and appliances as well. We have launched our first ever offline stores so that one can furnish their entire home, room or corner without traversing multiple stores or websites !

Key Responsibilities

**1. Search Engine Optimization (SEO) & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) – 80%**

* **Technical SEO:** Conduct regular technical SEO audits, identify and resolve crawling, indexing, site architecture, page speed, Core Web Vitals, and other technical issues to improve organic search performance.
* **On-Page SEO:** Optimize website pages, landing pages, metadata, headings, internal linking, URLs, and content structure to improve keyword rankings, organic visibility, and user experience.
* **SEO Content Strategy:** Develop and execute SEO-led content strategies, including keyword research, search intent analysis, content gap analysis, competitor benchmarking, and content optimization to drive qualified organic traffic.
* **GEO & AI Search Optimization:** Optimize website content for AI-powered search platforms and answer engines through structured Q&A content, semantic formatting, entity optimization, schema markup, and authoritative brand mentions to improve visibility in AI-generated responses.
* **Keyword Research & Competitor Analysis:** Identify high-intent, commercial, and informational keywords; analyze competitor strategies; and discover opportunities to improve rankings and organic market share.
* **Off-Page SEO & Link Building:** Develop backlink acquisition and digital PR strategies to strengthen domain authority, improve search rankings, and increase brand credibility across relevant websites and digital platforms.
* **Schema Markup & Structured Data:** Implement and optimize structured data to improve search engine understanding, enhance eligibility for rich results, and support AI search discoverability.
* **SEO Performance Monitoring:** Track organic traffic, keyword rankings, click-through rates, impressions, conversions, and technical health using Google Search Console, GA4, and other SEO tools.
* **SEO Analytics & Reporting:** Build SEO dashboards, monitor key performance indicators, identify growth opportunities, and present actionable insights through regular performance reviews.
* **Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO):** Optimize organic landing pages, website journeys, and calls to action to improve engagement, lead generation, and conversion rates from organic traffic.
* **Continuous Testing & Optimization:** Conduct SEO experiments, content refreshes, internal linking improvements, and landing page tests to improve organic visibility and sustainable traffic growth.

**Answer Engine Optimization (AEO):** Optimize website content to improve visibility across answer engines and AI-powered platforms by creating concise, authoritative, question-led content, FAQs, structured answers, and relevant schema markup. Focus on capturing featured snippets, People Also Ask results, voice search queries, and AI-generated answers to strengthen brand visibility and drive qualified organic traffic.

**2. Performance Marketing & Growth Optimization – 20%**

* **Paid Campaign Support:** Collaborate on paid search and digital acquisition campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads and Meta Ads to support business growth and customer acquisition.
* **Campaign Performance Analysis:** Monitor campaign performance, cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), conversion rates, and other key metrics to identify optimization opportunities.
* **Landing Page Optimization:** Work with design, content, and performance teams to improve landing page relevance, messaging, user experience, and conversion rates across paid and organic traffic.
* **Analytics & Tracking:** Support accurate conversion tracking and attribution through GA4, Google Tag Manager, and relevant marketing analytics tools.
* **Experimentation & Funnel Optimization:** Assist with A/B testing of landing pages, ad creatives, calls to action, and conversion funnels to improve acquisition efficiency.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with brand, content, product, and performance marketing teams to align digital initiatives with business objectives and ensure consistent brand messaging across channels.

title: Assistant Branch Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**

To lead branch setup and operational readiness, drive business growth in gold lending, build and manage a high-performing branch team, and ensure strict compliance with internal audit standards and regulatory (RBI) guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Branch Recruitment & Team Building:**
* Source, interview, and hire local talent for key branch roles, including Gold Valuers/Appraisers, Customer Service Officers, Relationship Managers, and Security Personnel.
* Coordinate with HR to manage local hiring pipelines, campus/walk-in drives, and employee onboarding.
* Plan branch staffing levels based on business volume and operational requirements.
* Oversee initial product, compliance, and gold-appraisal training for newly onboarded staff.
* **Business Development & Sales:**
* Drive branch sales targets for gold loan disbursements, cross-selling products, and new customer acquisition.

* **Gold Operations & Risk Management:**
* Ensure accurate gold testing, weighing, and purity assessment following standard appraisal protocols.
* Strictly adhere to Loan-to-Value (LTV) limits and regulatory guidelines.
* Supervise safe vault management, dual-custody procedures, and daily packet verification to protect pledged gold assets.
* **Operations & Compliance:**
* Oversee daily branch transactions, cash management, and operational workflows.
* Maintain compliance with company policies, RBI guidelines, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) norms.
* Ensure smooth internal and external audit processes and resolve audit queries promptly.
* **Portfolio & Recovery Management:**
* Track overdue loans and lead recovery efforts for early-stage delinquent accounts (0–30 days past due).
* Coordinate loan closure, redemption processes, and statutory auctions for non-performing accounts per legal guidelines.
* **Team Leadership & Customer Service:**
* Manage, mentor, and retain branch staff, providing regular performance evaluations and coaching.
* Resolve escalated customer grievances and ensure high-quality service delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Hiring & Retention:** Time-to-fill for open branch positions, staff onboarding timeline, and branch attrition rate.
* **Growth:** Total Assets Under Management (AUM) and monthly disbursement volume.
* **Risk & Portfolio:** Non-Performing Assets (NPA) percentage and audit compliance score.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 3–8 years in banking/NBFC operations, with proven experience in branch management, team hiring, and gold loan processing.
* **Technical Skills:** Interviewing techniques, knowledge of gold appraisal methods, basic accounting, and branch management software.
* **Soft Skills:** Talent acquisition, team leadership, conflict resolution, sales strategy, and local language proficiency.

* 5+ years of relevant experience, including independent ownership of Marketing Operations improvements beyond campaign execution.

* Ability to evaluate behavioral signals, explain performance and deliver measurable improvements.
* Knowledge of email deliverability best practices and marketing automation.
* Experience with marketing attribution and funnel analysis.
* Experience with Salesforce reporting, CRM management and Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
* Experience managing marketing databases, segmentation, and data hygiene.
* Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets.

**Success Measures**

* Accurate and timely execution of global email campaigns, with reduced turnaround time and manual effort.
* A reliable marketing database with effective audience segmentation and fewer recurring data errors.
* Reliable dashboards and reporting that support business decisions.
* Improved lead qualification, funnel progression and Sales handoff quality.
* Adoption of reusable processes, automation and tools that improve team productivity and reduce workflow errors.
Measurable improvements in campaign performance and contribution to pipeline generation.

* A competitive compensation package

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Marketing AI and Personalization SME will define and drive AI-enabled marketing transformation. The role will identify, prioritize, and shape AI, generative AI, decisioning, and agentic AI use cases that improve marketing effectiveness, customer experience, and operational productivity.

The candidate should combine strong marketing knowledge with practical knowledge of AI capabilities. This is not an AI engineering role. The primary focus is on business use cases, solution shaping, operating models, adoption, responsible AI, and value realization.

**Key Responsibilities –**

**Marketing AI Strategy**

* Define the AI-enabled or AI-native marketing vision and transformation roadmap.
* Assess current marketing processes to identify opportunities for AI augmentation or automation.
* Prioritize AI use cases based on business value, feasibility, risk, data readiness, and adoption requirements.
* Define the role of AI across marketing planning, content, audiences, journeys, decisioning, operations, and measurement.
* Develop executive business cases and investment recommendations.

**Generative AI for Marketing**

* Define use cases for content ideation, generation, variation, summarization, review, and localization.
* Develop requirements for marketing copilots and knowledge assistants.
* Design human-in-the-loop processes for content generation, approval, and compliance review.
* Identify opportunities to reduce campaign development and content production cycle times.
* Define integration requirements between generative AI capabilities and content, campaign, and workflow platforms.

**Agentic Marketing**

* Identify marketing processes suitable for agent-based orchestration or automation.
* Define use cases for campaign planning, audience analysis, journey monitoring, content operations, marketing analytics, and performance optimization agents.
* Design human oversight, escalation, audit, and approval requirements.
* Collaborate with AI architects to define multi-agent workflows and platform requirements.
* Establish boundaries for autonomous and human-approved actions.

**AI-Driven Personalization and Decisioning**

* Define AI-enabled segmentation and propensity-based targeting strategies.
* Develop next-best-action, next-best-offer, and recommendation use cases.
* Define decisioning requirements, including eligibility, prioritization, suppression, arbitration, and contact policies.
* Help connect customer signals, predictive insights, contextual information, and business rules.
* Partner with analytics teams to define model use cases and measurement approaches.

**Job Description cont'd**
--------------------------

**Responsible AI and Governance**

* Define responsible AI controls for marketing use cases.
* Establish transparency, explainability, fairness, privacy, human oversight, and audit requirements.
* Identify risks related to hallucination, bias, intellectual property, inappropriate content, customer discrimination, and regulatory compliance.
* Collaborate with legal, privacy, compliance, model risk, security, and brand teams.
* Define monitoring requirements for AI-generated content and AI-driven customer decisions.

**AI Operating Model and Adoption**

* Define how marketing roles and processes will change through AI adoption.
* Develop the future-state interaction model between marketers, agencies, platforms, copilots, and AI agents.
* Identify new roles, skills, governance forums, and ways of working.
* Support change management, training, adoption, and workforce enablement.
* Create reusable Marketing AI playbooks and maturity models.

**Consulting and Pre-Sales**

* Lead Marketing AI ideation and prioritization workshops.
* Develop AI transformation proposals, proofs of concept, and executive presentations.
* Shape Marketing AI opportunities with business, technology, data, and AI stakeholders.
* Create Marketing AI points of view, demonstrations, accelerators, and reusable solutions.

**Primary skills**
------------------

* 10+ years of experience across marketing, personalization, customer analytics, marketing technology, AI consulting, or digital transformation.
* Strong understanding of marketing processes, customer journeys, segmentation, campaign management, and personalization.
* Practical knowledge of generative AI, predictive AI, decisioning, copilots, and agentic AI concepts.
* Experience identifying and prioritizing AI use cases.
* Understanding of responsible AI, privacy, risk, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Ability to communicate AI concepts to marketing and executive stakeholders without unnecessary technical complexity.
* Strong business-case development, workshop facilitation, and executive storytelling capabilities.

title: Marketing Partner, APAC Digital Hub
description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively**

We are looking for a strategic, insight-driven digital marketing professional who combines strong performance marketing expertise with market partnership, stakeholder management, and cross-functional coordination.

This is a lead-level individual contributor (IC) role within the APAC Digital Hub. As the dedicated Marketing Partner for assigned APAC markets, you will act as the primary interface between market stakeholders and the Digital Hub, understanding business and marketing priorities, translating them into actionable plans, and mobilising the right Hub capabilities to deliver against them.

Alongside this market-facing responsibility, you will bring strong performance marketing expertise across paid media, analytics, measurement, optimisation, and digital strategy, helping markets make informed marketing decisions and continuously improve performance.

As APAC markets increasingly transition away from external agency support, this role will play an important part in strengthening internal digital marketing capabilities and establishing the Digital Hub as a trusted marketing partner across the region.

Success in this role requires the ability to move seamlessly between strategic consultation, relationship management, cross-functional orchestration, and hands-on digital marketing execution, while balancing market relevance with regional and global priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

##### **1. Market Partnership & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary Digital Hub contact and Marketing Partner for assigned APAC markets.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with market marketing teams and relevant business stakeholders.
* Maintain regular and proactive engagement to understand business priorities, marketing needs, upcoming campaigns, launches, and potential challenges.
* Participate in market planning discussions, business reviews, campaign reviews, and relevant marketing governance forums.
* Align stakeholders on business objectives, strategic priorities, delivery timelines, decision points, and overall success criteria.
* Provide strategic marketing guidance while ensuring activities remain aligned with regional and global strategy, brand standards, and established ways of working.
* Represent market needs, challenges, and opportunities within the Digital Hub while helping markets understand and activate broader regional and global priorities.
* Maintain clear and transparent communication around priorities, progress, dependencies, risks, and next steps.

##### **2. Digital Hub Orchestration & Go-to-Market Enablement**

* Own the intake, clarification, prioritisation, and coordination of marketing requirements from assigned markets.
* Translate business and marketing needs into clear, actionable briefs for Digital Hub specialists.
* Mobilise and coordinate relevant Hub capabilities across Content, Creative, Website, SEO, Social Media, Performance Marketing, and Analytics.
* Connect specialist workstreams into cohesive marketing solutions rather than managing individual requests in isolation.
* Coordinate priorities, dependencies, timelines, and expectations across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Support regional and global product launches and strategic initiatives by coordinating digital readiness across relevant channels and workstreams.
* Identify potential delivery gaps, risks, or misalignment early and facilitate corrective action.
* Facilitate collaboration between markets, Digital Hub specialists, regional/global teams, and external partners where required.
* Identify opportunities to reuse and scale successful assets, campaigns, and approaches across APAC while maintaining appropriate local relevance.

##### **3. Paid Media Strategy & Campaign Management**

* Develop and manage paid media strategies across: Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, and Other relevant digital channels
* Build integrated media plans aligned with market objectives, target audiences, customer journeys, and available budgets.
* Recommend channel mix, audience targeting strategies, campaign structures, and budget allocation.
* Manage campaign activation, monitoring, optimisation, and continuous performance improvement.
* Evaluate campaign effectiveness against agreed objectives and recommend actions to improve ROI and lead quality.
* Advise markets on digital media opportunities and investment decisions based on performance data, market context, and business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and scale successful approaches across markets.

##### **4. Performance Analysis & Strategic Advisory**

* Own or coordinate monthly and quarterly digital performance reporting for assigned markets and contribute to broader APAC reporting.
* Translate campaign, website, social media, SEO, and wider digital performance into actionable business insights.
* Develop clear, insight-led reporting that explains what happened, why it happened, what actions should be taken next
* Identify cross-channel trends, business risks, market opportunities, and persistent performance gaps, and translate them into strategic recommendations for future planning and investment.
* Develop and maintain performance dashboards using GA4, Looker Studio, and other relevant reporting tools.
* Benchmark performance against historical results, relevant industry benchmarks, and regional trends.
* Use performance insights and market intelligence to inform campaign planning, channel selection, investment recommendations, and future marketing activity.
* Represent Digital Hub performance and contributions in relevant market business reviews and stakeholder forums.
* Bring market learnings back into the Digital Hub to help shape regional approaches, priorities, and future capabilities.
* Advise the Digital Hub Manager on aggregated market needs, recurring capability gaps, investment opportunities, and regional performance patterns across assigned markets.

##### **5. Analytics, Attribution & Conversion Optimisation**

* Develop and maintain campaign tracking frameworks and measurement governance.
* Ensure accurate performance measurement through: Google Analytics 4,Google Tag Manager,CRM integrations,UTM governance
* Support lead attribution and reporting through CRM platforms where applicable.
* Align stakeholders on KPIs, reporting frameworks, and measurement approaches.
* Collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to maintain reporting consistency and accuracy.
* Partner with Website, SEO, Content, and Creative specialists to identify opportunities to improve landing-page and customer-journey effectiveness.
* Support A/B testing and experimentation across audiences, creatives, messaging, channels, and landing pages.
* Ensure campaigns and digital initiatives launch with appropriate tracking and measurement mechanisms in place.

##### **6. Content, Localisation & Market Activation**

* Coordinate localisation requirements including translation, transcreation, and content adaptation.
* Assess when regional or global assets can be reused or adapted and when market needs require more specific localisation.
* Partner with Content and Creative specialists to ensure market requirements are translated into effective, locally relevant executions.
* Support market activation of regional and global campaign assets across relevant digital channels.
* Identify opportunities to make localisation and content adaptation more efficient and scalable through shared capabilities and emerging technologies.
* Ensure localised marketing activities remain aligned with applicable brand standards, approved claims, and regulatory requirements.

##### **7. Digital Operations & Problem Solving**

* Provide hands-on support for campaign, platform, tracking, measurement, and reporting-related issues affecting assigned markets.
* Troubleshoot issues across platforms including Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, GA4, GTM, and reporting tools.
* Diagnose campaign delivery issues, tracking discrepancies, conversion measurement challenges, and platform configuration concerns.
* Coordinate incident resolution across relevant Digital Hub specialists when operational issues span Website, SEO, Content, Creative, Analytics, or Social Media, ensuring clear ownership and follow-through.
* Escalate and coordinate with global teams, vendors, or platform support teams where required.
* Provide practical guidance and best practices that strengthen market capabilities and improve digital ways of working.

##### **8. AI & Marketing Innovation**

* Explore and implement AI-powered tools to improve campaign planning, optimisation, reporting, localisation, content workflows, and operational efficiency.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and marketing innovations that could improve market outcomes or Digital Hub scalability.
* Stay updated on developments in AI-driven marketing, automation, media platforms, analytics, and performance measurement.
* Support responsible adoption of AI-assisted marketing processes and best practices across the Digital Hub and assigned markets.

* Google Ads
* Meta Business Manager
* LinkedIn Campaign Manager
* Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
* Google Tag Manager (GTM)
* Looker Studio
* Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets – Advanced
* ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or equivalent AI tools
* Nice to Have
* Salesforce or other CRM platforms
* HubSpot
* Microsoft Clarity
* Hotjar
* SEMrush
* Ahrefs
* Marketing project/workflow management platforms

##### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business, Analytics, Communications, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience across Performance Marketing, Digital Marketing, Integrated Marketing, Growth Marketing, or related roles.
* Strong hands-on experience in paid media, campaign management, analytics, attribution, reporting, and performance optimisation.
* Demonstrated experience acting as a strategic marketing partner or primary stakeholder contact, ideally supporting multiple markets, business units, or clients.
* Experience translating business requirements into integrated marketing plans and coordinating delivery across specialist teams.
* Demonstrated ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on campaign management, platform administration, troubleshooting, and stakeholder engagement.
* Experience managing or supporting campaigns across multiple markets or regions.
* Strong ability to translate data into strategic recommendations, business insights, and clear stakeholder narratives.
* Strong stakeholder management, presentation, communication, and influencing skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders in a matrixed environment without relying on direct authority.
* Experience working within regional or global marketing teams is preferred.

###### **Ways of Working**

* Proactive and consultative: Anticipates market needs and brings recommendations rather than waiting for requests.
* Commercially and digitally minded: Connects marketing activities and performance data with wider business objectives.
* Collaborative: Brings together specialist expertise and stakeholders to solve problems and deliver outcomes.
* Structured: Manages multiple markets, priorities, dependencies, and deadlines effectively.
* Influential: Builds alignment through expertise, relationships, and evidence rather than direct authority.
* Solution-oriented: Focuses on achieving outcomes while navigating constraints and ambiguity.
* Curious: Continuously explores better approaches, technologies, and opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness.

* At least one campaign case study outlining objectives, strategy, channels used, performance results, key learnings, and optimisation recommendations.

**Director, MXDR Product**

**Level**

Director

  

**Function**

Product Engineering & Development — MXDR (Managed Extended Detection & Response)

  

**Experience**

15–20 years, including 5+ years leading a security or infrastructure product at scale

**Role Summary**
================

The Director, MXDR Product owns the MXDR product line end-to-end — strategy, roadmap, delivery, and outcomes. This person sits at the intersection of engineering, architecture, security operations, sales, and customer success, converting technical capability into a coherent product that customers trust and buy. They will partner closely with the Senior Architect (who continues to own technical architecture) while taking full ownership of product direction, delivery commitments, cross-functional alignment, and executive/customer communication.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Product Ownership & Strategy**
--------------------------------

* Own the MXDR product roadmap end-to-end — define priorities, sequence releases, and make explicit trade-off calls between customer asks, competitive pressure, and technical debt.
* Translate market and customer signal (win/loss reviews, analyst reports, competitive intelligence, compliance requirements like FedRAMP/SOC 2) into a defensible product strategy.
* Own the business case for major initiatives — cost, timeline, staffing, and expected outcome — before they go to engineering, closing the gap between "good architecture" and "fundable roadmap."

**Delivery Ownership**
----------------------

* Own delivery predictability: turn architecture and design work into resourced, sequenced, trackable delivery plans with realistic timelines.
* Run the cadence that keeps delivery visible — regular progress reviews, clear status reporting (RAG/roadmap-vs-actual), and early escalation of risk rather than late surprises.
* Partner with the Senior Architect and engineering leads to convert technical designs into shippable phases with clear acceptance criteria and success metrics.

**Stakeholder Management & Communication**
------------------------------------------

* Be the primary product point of contact for CTO, executive leadership, and key customers — comfortable presenting roadmap, risk, and trade-offs to non-technical and executive audiences.
* Manage the inevitable tension between sales commitments, customer requests, and engineering capacity — and be the one who says no, with a clear rationale, when needed.
* Build and maintain trust with cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, SOC/security operations, sales, marketing, customer success, compliance) so the product roadmap reflects real constraints from every side, not just engineering's.

**Ownership & Accountability**
------------------------------

* Take end-to-end accountability for product outcomes — not just what was designed or built, but what shipped, what customers adopted, and what moved the business forward.
* Proactively surface risk (technical, delivery, market, compliance) rather than waiting to be asked — and bring a recommended path forward, not just a problem.
* Own post-release outcomes: adoption, customer feedback, support burden, and whether the product delivered the value it was built for.

**Domain & Technical Fluency**
------------------------------

* Be fluent enough in MXDR/SOC concepts (detection engineering, threat hunting, SIEM/UEBA/ITDR, incident response workflows, MITRE ATT&CK) to have a credible technical conversation with architects, customers, and analysts — without needing to be the one designing the models.
* Understand the compliance and certification landscape relevant to security products (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, GDPR) well enough to factor it into roadmap decisions early, not as an afterthought.
* Expertise in building AI based SDLC using AI tools.

**AI/ML, LLM, and Innovation Strategy**

* **GenAI & LLM Integration:** Design the architectural blueprint for embedding Generative AI and LLMs (via commercial APIs like OpenAI/Anthropic or open-source models like Llama/Mistral) into our existing products to deliver next-generation customer value.
* **Machine Learning Pipelines:** Leverage the **Python** ecosystem to oversee the creation of scalable ML data pipelines, MLOps frameworks, and predictive modeling features that enhance our application's intelligent capabilities.
* **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG):** Architect advanced RAG systems combining **Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch as a vector database)** and SQL to enable high-performance, context-aware semantic search and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* **AI Security & Governance:** Establish enterprise-wide compliance, data privacy (preventing PII leakage into LLMs), and ethical guardrails for AI usage, ensuring alignment with emerging global AI regulations.
* **Internal AI Automation:** Lead initiatives to leverage AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and automated testing tools to improve overall engineering team velocity and code quality.

**Executive Technology Strategy & Enterprise Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Long-Term Technical Vision**: Define and execute a 3-to-5-year technology roadmap that scales with the company’s business growth, shifting engineering from a reactive delivery unit to a proactive business driver.
* **Polyglot Stack Governance:** Establish modern architectural guardrails and engineering standards for our composite ecosystem—ensuring seamless, secure integration between enterprise Angular frontends, distributed Python services, and high-performance .NET Web APIs.

description:
**Job Description \- Site Operations \& Inventory Control Manager**

**Role Overview:**

The **Site Operations \& Inventory Control Manager** will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end ecommerce fulfillment site operations, including inbound, putaway, inventory control, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, cycle count, stock reconciliation, vendor discrepancy reporting, manpower productivity, SLA adherence, and SOP compliance.The role will act as the **single point of ownership for site performance, inventory accuracy, inbound quality, process discipline, and operational issue resolution**. The person will ensure that the warehouse operates efficiently, stock records remain accurate, and all incoming and outgoing inventory movements are controlled as per brand standards.

**You should apply if you have:**

* A strong interest in Site Operations and Inventory Control Management.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills for ecommerce warehouse and fulfilment operations
* A problem\-solving mindset with the ability to work in fast\-paced, high\-growth environment
* Ownership\-driven attitude—comfortable taking charge of projects end\-to\-end
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines

**You should not apply if you:**

* Struggle with ownership and require constant supervision to drive tasks
* Are uncomfortable working with data, numbers, or analytical problem\-solving
* Are not willing to collaborate with cross\-functional teams or external partners
* Avoid negotiation, communication, or vendor/brand interaction

**Skills Required**

* Strong understanding of ecommerce warehouse and fulfilment operations.
* Good command over inbound, GRN, inventory control, dispatch, returns, and audit processes.
* Knowledge of SKU, batch, expiry, MRP, barcode, PO, invoice, ASN, GRN, and stock adjustment processes.
* Strong attention to detail and counting accuracy.
* Ability to identify stock discrepancies, quality issues, and process gaps.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets / MIS reporting skills.
* Understanding of WMS, OMS, ERP, and courier systems; Vinculum knowledge preferred.
* Ability to manage third\-party manpower and ensure SOP compliance.

**What you will do:**

**1\. End\-to\-End Site Operations Management**

* Own daily warehouse / darkstore operations including inbound, putaway, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and inventory control.
* Ensure orders are processed within defined cut\-off times and SLA timelines.
* Monitor daily order volume, pending orders, aging orders, SLA breaches, and operational bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with central operations, logistics, product, inventory planning, procurement, finance, and customer support teams.
* Ensure smooth order fulfilment across B2C, marketplace, darkstore, and other ecommerce channels, wherever applicable.

**2\. SLA \& Performance Management**

* Track and improve key operational metrics, including order processing TAT, dispatch TAT, pick\-pack accuracy, inventory accuracy, manpower productivity, and order breach percentage.
* Review site performance daily through dashboards, MIS, exception reports, and pending trackers.
* Identify recurring operational issues and drive corrective actions.
* Prepare daily / weekly performance updates for leadership review.
* Highlight operational risks proactively with root cause and action plan.

**3\. Inventory Accuracy \& Stock Governance**

* Ensure accurate stock storage, bin mapping, SKU hygiene, batch tracking, expiry tracking, FEFO / FIFO adherence, and stock reconciliation.
* Conduct and supervise daily, weekly, and monthly cycle counts as per audit plan.
* Verify physical stock against system stock at SKU, batch, expiry, MRP, and bin level.
* Identify stock mismatches, short / excess quantities, wrong bin placements, missing labels, unscannable barcodes, and location errors.
* Monitor shrinkage, damaged stock, expired stock, dead stock, slow\-moving stock, and high\-value inventory.
* Ensure expired, damaged, leaked, or unsellable stock is quarantined and marked correctly.
* Maintain strict controls for high\-value, fast\-moving, fragile, and expiry\-sensitive SKUs.

**4\. Inbound Audit \& GRN Control**

* Audit incoming stock against PO, invoice, ASN, delivery challan, and system records.
* Verify SKU name, SKU code, quantity, batch number, expiry date, MRP, barcode, and packaging condition.
* Ensure received stock matches system expectations before GRN closure.
* Identify shortages, excess quantity, wrong SKUs, duplicate items, damaged products, near\-expiry stock, expired stock, leakage, tampering, or invoice mismatch.
* Validate GRN entries for accuracy and ensure all discrepancies are recorded before stock acceptance.
* Prevent unauthorized inwarding of stock without PO or required approval.
* Ensure only audited and approved stock moves to putaway.

**5\. Vendor, Transporter \& Discrepancy Management**

* Report vendor\-side and transporter\-side issues such as wrong dispatch, short supply, excess supply, damaged goods, expiry mismatch, MRP mismatch, or invoice mismatch.
* Capture proper evidence through photos, quantity records, signed discrepancy notes, and audit reports.
* Maintain inbound discrepancy logs, rejection reports, vendor issue reports, damage reports, and GRN correction records.
* Coordinate with procurement, planning, finance, and warehouse teams for discrepancy closure.
* Track vendor discrepancy closure and ensure repeated issues are escalated with data.

**6\. Putaway, Storage \& Bin Discipline**

* Ensure stock is moved from the receiving area to the correct storage / bin location within defined TAT.
* Validate correct labeling, barcode scanning, batch tagging, expiry marking, and SKU placement before storage.
* Prevent wrong putaway of unaudited or rejected stock.
* Ensure bin accuracy across racks, storage zones, pick faces, and bulk locations.
* Identify mixed SKUs, wrong bin mapping, wrong batch placement, and missing labels.
* Coordinate correction of bin\-level discrepancies with warehouse team.

**7\. Team \& Manpower Management**

* Monitor whether warehouse staff, supervisors, pickers, packers, auditors, and third\-party manpower are following brand\-defined SOPs.
* Plan manpower as per order load, sale days, campaigns, and business peaks.
* Conduct daily briefings to align teams on order priorities, pending workload, SLA risks, and process discipline.
* Track manpower productivity and identify areas of underutilization or bottleneck.
* Ensure clear shift\-wise ownership for inbound, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, and audits.

**8\. Process Compliance \& Site Audit**

* Ensure SOP adherence across inbound, storage, putaway, picking, packing, dispatch, returns, cycle count, and stock adjustment processes.
* Perform site audits in accordance with brand guidelines.
* Maintain documentation for audits, stock movements, damages, GRN, dispatches, returns, rejected stock, and stock adjustments.
* Ensure all stock adjustments are properly documented and approved as per the process.
* Support internal and external audits with required data and records.
* Ensure safety, hygiene, security, and compliance standards are followed at the site.

**9\. Returns \& Reverse Inventory Control**

* Ensure returned stock is received, audited, QC\-checked, and moved to the correct inventory status.
* Validate return discrepancies such as wrong item received, missing item, damaged item, used product, or non\-sellable return.
* Track return\-to\-sellable %, return QC TAT, and rejected return stock.
* Coordinate with customer support, logistics, and finance teams for return closure and refund\-related dependencies.

**10\. Issue Resolution \& Escalation**

* Act as the first escalation point for site\-level operational and inventory\-related issues.
* Resolve issues related to stock mismatch, GRN errors, order delays, manpower shortage, courier handover delays, return discrepancies, system discrepancies, and damaged stock.
* Prepare RCA for repeated inventory mismatches, inbound discrepancies, dispatch delays, and SOP deviations.
* Escalate critical risks proactively with data, business impact, and corrective action plan.

**Work Experience**

**3–5 years** in ecommerce operations, warehouse management, inventory control, inbound operations, stock audit, darkstore operations, retail fulfillment, supply chain operations, FMCG, supplement, pharma\-like product handling, or logistics operations.Experience in a **D2C, ecommerce, supplement, FMCG, pharma, beauty, or personal care warehouse** will be preferred because these categories require tighter control over expiry, batch, MRP, damage, leakage, and return quality.

**Working days: 6 Days** 

**WorkingLocation:** Survey no. 47, mylapura village, jadigennahalli hobli, Hoskote Taluk, Begaluru Rural District, Pincode 562114

**Perks:**

* Friendly atmosphere
* High learning \& personal growth opportunity
* Flexible Timings
* Diverse work environment
